correctness.rationale: The killed half-line sine transform q_x(h) gives E[q_x(tau sum lambda_j)] and the spectral power phi(tau(1-cos theta))^n. Integration by parts/Karamata yields 1-phi(s)~k sqrt(pi s)(log(1/s))^beta. Scaling theta=z/[n(log n)^beta] and the explicit Potter bound establishes integrable dominance; the zero-angle sine kernel tends to 2x. Converting n=t/tau gives the constant. Layer cake proves the all-p moments and Erlang survival of log of the Pareto product gives beta=m-1. Fixed x,tau, independently resampled strictly positive rates essential. Independent bounded checks confirm Erlang survival with numerical quadrature but do not prove time asymptotics.
